messages:
anna (Product PM): quick sync — customers keep asking for streaming with deterministic finish reasons and smaller deltas. need a decision: SSE vs WS, delta envelope format, and what finish_reason semantics we expose.

mike (Eng - runtime): +1 urgent for a few early enterprise pilots. main tradeoffs: SSE is simpler for HTTP stacks, WS gives multiplexing + binary frames.

julia (Eng - infra): from infra POV websockets complicate load balancers and autoscaling a bit. SSE -> easier to terminate and retry, but harder if clients need binary chunks.

sam (Platform): also think about routing: Hosted API -> we can add a proxy layer to normalize both to same internal wire format if needed. but that adds product latency.

lee (Customer Success): customers want two things: 1) a clear finish_reason on final event (not inferred from connection close) and 2) a minimal schema for delta messages to make parsing lightweight for mobile SDKs.

mike (Eng - runtime): proposal draft:
- streaming transport: support both SSE and WS (beta). prefer SSE for initial GA on REST endpoints because it fits existing SDKs. WS reserved for realtime / multiplexed flows.
- delta envelope: JSON lines with small header fields: {"id":"...","seq":N,"type":"delta","delta":"..."} and a final message {"type":"done","finish_reason":"stop"}.

julia (Eng - infra): question: do we require monotonic seq numbers? reordering could happen in some proxies. if we require monotonic seq, infra needs to guarantee ordering paths per connection.

mike (Eng - runtime): we should include seq and a small checksum. if client sees gaps they can request missing parts via REST replay. not all clients will implement replay.

anna (Product PM): launch criteria idea:
- Beta: SSE supported in hosted API, delta JSON-lines, explicit done event with finish_reason (enum: stop, length, max_tokens, cancelled, error). docs + example clients.
- GA: WS support + binary delta variant, SDKs for mobile + JS, replay endpoint for missing segments, perf SLOs met (p50 token latency < 80ms for 8k avg seq).

sam (Platform): we should also enumerate failure modes and expected client behavior for each finish_reason. example: "cancelled" -> server sent a cancellation because of policy or customer cancellation. "error" -> include an error code field in the done event.

lee (Customer Success): customers pushing for an additional finish_reason "fallback_model" when we switch to a cheaper model mid-stream. they want explicit signal for quality-monitoring.

mike (Eng - runtime): hmm that complicates guarantees. if we fallback mid-stream we must either close and emit done then start new stream, or emit an in-stream event {"type":"model_switch","from":"v1","to":"v0-small"}. both are possible.

anna (Product PM): decision options to vote on:
1) Minimal: SSE-only beta, JSON-lines deltas, done event with base enum (stop, length, max_tokens, cancelled, error). defer model_switch signal to GA.
2) Broad: SSE + WS from day 1, support model_switch and replay for gaps, include seq & checksum. longer dev timeline.

julia (Eng - infra): risk note: WS from day1 increases infra config work + LB sticky sessions. estimate +3 sprints.

sam (Platform): perf note: adding replay introduces extra storage and indexing for short-term tokens. small cost but good UX for flaky mobile.

anna (Product PM): quick strawpoll — react with :one: for Minimal, :two: for Broad. we'll use this to scope roadmap for Q2.

infra-bot: deploy scheduled: streaming-prototype -> staging at 2026-03-14T09:20:00Z :rocket:

mike (Eng - runtime): my vote :two: but OK to phase (start with Minimal + clear GA plan).

lee (Customer Success): customers asking now -> :two: if we can commit to concrete dates. otherwise :one:.

julia (Eng - infra): :one: realistically.

sam (Platform): :two: with a conditional: GA plan must include perf budgets and infra checklist.

anna (Product PM): thanks all. action items:
- mike: write a short spec for delta envelope + done event (include error codes & finish_reason enum). due Tue 3/17.
- julia: infra checklist for SSE vs WS (LB, sticky sessions, retries). due Fri 3/20.
- sam: cost estimate for replay storage and SDK effort. due Wed 3/18.
- lee: surface a prioritized customer list for early pilots. due Mon 3/16.

mike (Eng - runtime): will post spec PR with example payloads. sample SSE frame: 

```
event: message
data: {"id":"abc123","seq":1,"type":"delta","delta":"Hello"}

```

final done example:

```
event: message
data: {"id":"abc123","type":"done","finish_reason":"stop"}

```

anna (Product PM): perfect. i'll turn this into a short roadmap blurb and add to the Q2 initiative board. will follow up on the strawpoll results by EOD. :white_check_mark:
